title: Bluesky’s AI tool now lets you make games and apps to share on social
hook_before: Bluesky now lets you build apps and games directly on the social network.
script:
Bluesky replaces complex development with a simple AI. It lets you build apps and games directly on the social network.
This expansion uses the Attie AI tool, which previously only managed custom feeds.
Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider says you can create small web-based tools like polls and dashboards.
You share these creations as standalone websites for other users to interact with.
Schneider revealed these features live at the TechCrunch Disrupt event this week.
The goal is turning a social feed into a functional software playground.
It's a massive shift from simple text posts to interactive user-made software.
Could you build a viral game today?
